join hortbot 999 foobar 1


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=admin :!admin reloadrepeats
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=super-admin :!admin reloadrepeats
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Reloaded 0 repeats and 0 schedules in 0s.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add repeatme Hello there!
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme 600
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=super-admin :!admin reloadrepeats
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Reloaded 1 repeat and 0 schedules in 0s.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add repeatme2 Hello there!
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule add repeatme2 *_*_*_*_*
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 access=super-admin :!admin reloadrepeats
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Reloaded 1 repeat and 1 schedule in 0s.
